description: Start processing a previously created log export job. This is asynchronous, only queues the export, and does not return rows or a download file; use get_log_export to poll progress and download_log_export after the job completes. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.

export_id.description: The unique ID of the log export to start

name: start_log_export

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
